text:
jared: Monthly pattern scan pulled. Top recurring issue this quarter: cluster-degradation (sig-C). Thread to assign owners, realistic ETAs, and concrete ACs.

vivian: I can take sig-C short-term mitigation (circuit + throttles). ETA 5 business days for mitigation and 3 weeks for full remediation design.

omar: I'll own rollout + monitoring changes. Need capacity confirmation for node replacement (CAP-9120). Filed the ticket.

lina: I will handle alert tuning and SLO adjustments. Will draft new alert thresholds and add alert suppression windows to avoid noisy pages.

ops-bot: Automated summary: pattern-scan run=2026-04-22; occurrences=29; signatures discovered=[sig-A,sig-B,sig-C]; followups created: PM-1309,PM-1310.

jared: Please populate the tracker row: owner | ticket | ETA | AC | fallback. Link: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/INC-TRACKER>. Use realistic ETAs (pad for approvals).

vivian: Short-term mitigation commands I used in staging (worked):
```
# add circuit breaker and lower batch size
rgctl routes update --route computePoolC --circuit 60 --window 30
rgctl nodes update --pool computePoolC --batch-size 8
```

vivian: Staging smoke 4h -> 0 recurrences. Will run 24h and post logs.

omar: CAP-9120: capacity replied needing perf numbers and cost estimate. Pinged @infra-team and linked the staging report.

infra-team: Received CAP-9120. We need 72h to assess. If approved, nodes can be provisioned in ~10 days.

lina: For ACs: example for sig-C mitigation: "no customer-facing 5xx anomalies for 14d and avg tail latency <250ms under baseline load". Also include automatic rollback triggers.

jared: Good. Add the monitoring query to the tracker. Example: `sum(rate(http_errors_total{sig=\"sig-C\"}[5m])) > 3` and alert on sustained >3 for 15m.

vivian: If capacity is delayed, fallback is to reduce concurrency and enable mem-quantization on the model-serving tier. Expect ~8-12% latency increase. Documented in the tracker.

omar: I'll draft the rollout plan with canary stages: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100% and auto-fallback on error spike >2x baseline. ETA for doc: 5 business days.

lina: I'll update alert runbooks and add suppression windows during canary. Also setting up a dashboard tile for quick ops checks.

ops-bot: Reminder: follow-up rows must include acceptance criteria and monitoring queries. Use template: owner | ticket | ETA | AC | fallback.

jared: Weekly owner for this thread? Who will post Friday status updates?

vivian: I'll post weekly status every Friday and update the tracker. If blocked, I'll escalate in #eng-infra.

omar: Noted. If CAP-9120 not approved in 72h, I'll switch to routing-split fallback and mark ETA changes in tracker.

lina: Putting runbook links in the tracker now. Also adding the pager duty rotation for the follow-up.

jared: Thanks all. Closing this slack thread — tracker is source of truth. If you add anything, include the monitoring query and AC. Will schedule a 15-min standup Wednesday if CAP-9120 needs live unblock. :white_check_mark:
